title: どこへも Verb ないです (doko e mo + Verb + nai desu)
shortExplanation: Express that an action doesn't take place anywhere; 'nowhere', 'not anywhere'.
longExplanation: The どこへも + Verb ないです grammar point is used to express a situation where an action doesn't occur or isn't applicable anywhere. It emphasizes a strong sense of not performing the action anywhere. Keep in mind that only negative verbs can follow 'どこへも' in this construction.
formation: どこへも + Verb in negative form (ないです)

examples.jp: 今週末どこへも行かないです。
examples.romaji: Konshuumatsu doko e mo ikanai desu.
examples.en: I'm not going anywhere this weekend.

examples.jp: 彼女はどこへも買い物に行きませんでした。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa doko e mo kaimono ni ikimasen deshita.

examples.jp: スーパーはどこへも売らないです。
examples.romaji: Suupaa wa doko e mo uranai desu.
examples.en: It's not sold at any supermarket.

examples.jp: 私はどこへも行く予定がないです。
examples.romaji: Watashi wa doko e mo iku yotei ga nai desu.
examples.en: I have no plans to go anywhere.

usageNote: Slightly more conversational variant, ないです instead of ません. (どこへも variant.)
